segments.name: Retail food
segments.description: Operates conventional supermarkets selling groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy services and fuel to retail customers in Pennsylvania and surrounding states.
segments.evidence: The Company's operations are reported as a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Retail customers pay the Company for food, pharmacy and fuel purchases at its supermarkets, in store, online or via delivery.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company is engaged principally in the retail sale of food in Pennsylvania and surrounding states.
